name: MalletStation
summary: Single-port family. Application reports SysEx product ID LSB 39 (0x27); bootloader re-enumerates under its own distinct product string "malletStation Bootloader".

notes: applicationPidMsb confirmed from EM1_uv5/USB/USB_Descriptor.h (PID 0x27, PID_MSB 0x00). bootloaderPidMsb is NOT yet hardware-confirmed - the bootloader's own source isn't present in the marimba_firmware repo (it's a vendored prebuilt binary), so this follows the same 0/1 convention used by other KMI families pending verification against a real device or the bootloader's own source.
Requests a reboot into bootloader mode while the device still reports as malletStation.
Single monolithic SysEx message (85531 bytes, one F0...F7 pair), not Hex_to_SysEx-chunked. Predates this family's registration in sendsysex; kept for reference/compatibility.

Chunk-safe (-cs512) packaging via Hex_to_SysEx, paired with bootloader v1.0.3. Built and version-matched to EM1_uv5/Main/version.h 2026-07-29; not yet hardware-validated (see marimba_firmware's .buddy-project/blockers.md).
Distinct product string from the application (unlike K-Board, whose bootloader keeps the app's product string and is disambiguated only by PID MSB) - see identity.notes for MSB caveat.
